claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Eugenol at 2.5 uM is expected to be largely inactive against cancer cell lines; its annotated androgen receptor antagonism is weak and its known bioactivity (membrane disruption, antibacterial, antioxidant) occurs at much higher concentrations, so no coherent selective killing pattern is expected.
